tools.name: search_pionra
tools.description: Search Pionra guides, housing, jobs, communities, events, and directory pages with citation-ready links.

tools.name: list_communities
tools.description: List Pionra country communities that match a query.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Get a Pionra community hub plus recent posts for a given country code.

tools.name: find_housing
tools.description: Find housing listings on Pionra by city, budget, and room count.

tools.name: find_jobs
tools.description: Find job listings on Pionra by city, language, and contract type.

tools.name: recent_events
tools.description: List upcoming Pionra events, optionally filtered by city and date.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Fetch a full Pionra guide (Markdown body) by public id, or the best-matching guide for a search query. The text is returned in the requested locale when a translation exists.

tools.name: publish_guide
tools.description: Publish a guide, question, blog post, classified listing, marketplace item, or service offer to Pionra (enters the moderation queue before going live). Supports GUIDE, QUESTION, BLOG, ANNONCE, MARCHE, and SERVICE. Requires an API key sent as an `Authorization: Bearer pionra_sk_...` header — generate

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "publish_guide" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Publish a guide, question, blog post, classified listing, marketplace item, or service offer to Pionra (enters the moderation queue before going live). Supports…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_community · Private data: publish_guide · Public sink: publish_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_community · Private data: publish_guide · Public sink: publish_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
